db_user.description: Database username for Manila share service.

db_password.description: Password for Manila database user. Required.

db_host.description: Hostname or IP of the database server.

rabbit_ssl_version.description: SSL/TLS version to use (e.g., TLSv1_2, PROTOCOL_TLSv1_2).

log_file.description: Path to log file for share service. Empty for stdout.

log_level.description: Minimum log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

driver_handles_share_servers.description: If true, Manila manages share servers; if false, uses traditional shared model.

glusterfs_backend_name.description: Name of the GlusterFS backend for reporting.

glusterfs_volume.description: Name of the GlusterFS volume to export.

glusterfs_server_password.description: Password for GlusterFS server root user (required for native mode).

glusterfs_hosts.description: List of GlusterFS server hostnames or IPs.

items.description: FQDN or IP of GlusterFS node.

default_share_network.description: UUID of default share network (leave blank for auto-select).

default_share_type.description: Name of default share type to use when none specified.

security_service_type.description: Security service type: 'ldap', 'kerberos', or empty for none.

share_server_ip_pool.description: CIDR range for share server IPs (e.g., '192.168.100.0/24'). Required if driver_handles_share_servers=true.

max_request_size.description: Maximum request body size in bytes (default 100 MB).

max_api_request_size.description: Maximum size for API request headers/body (default 1 MB).

rpc_response_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for RPC responses.

share_workers.description: Number of worker processes for RPC handling. List for multi-worker configs (e.g., [2, 2] for two pools).

items.description: Number of workers in this pool.

service_host.description: Hostname to report this service instance as (defaults to FQDN).

service_topic.description: RabbitMQ topic for share RPC messages.

report_interval.description: Interval in seconds between service state reports.

delete_share_server_with_instances.description: If true, deletes share servers even when instances are attached.

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name for Manila service.

keystone_token_cache_time.description: Token cache expiry in seconds (0 to disable).

keystone_verify_certs.description: If true, validate Keystone certificates using CA bundle; otherwise allow insecure connections.

keystone_cafile.description: Path to CA bundle for Keystone TLS verification.

notifications_driver.description: Notification backend: 'messagingv2' recommended for notifications via RabbitMQ.
